approach: Static recompilation of the PPU code to C with ps3recomp and of the SPU programs, HLE system libraries, Direct3D 12 RSX backend; a launcher builds each game on your PC from your own copy
help: Testing on Windows itself (the project's own runs are under Proton on Linux)
Testing on AMD and Intel GPUs
Testing the Linux launcher on more distributions
notes: Early work, not playable. One card for the collection's three games (Ratchet & Clank 1, 2 and 3, the PS2 remasters), since each builds into its own program from the same disc. A scripted new game of each reaches its first level with the player under scripted control (one build each: R&C 1 and R&C 3 on Veldin, R&C 2 on Aranos); none was played by hand. Needs your own copy of the game and the decrypted EBOOT made from it; the launcher builds the game on your PC. The project's own test runs use the Windows program under Proton on Linux (the Linux launcher starts it that way); players have reported results from Windows itself.
